meta.name: Score DR readiness and create remediation and alerts from DR tooling

name: AI Disaster Recovery Readiness Agent - Backup, RDS, Replication, IaC & Runbook Scoring

parameters.content:
## 🧯 AI Disaster Recovery Readiness Agent

Periodically inspects backups, RDS/database snapshots, cross-region replication, infrastructure-as-code (IaC) state, and recovery runbooks — then computes a single weighted DR Readiness Score (0-100), identifies specific gaps, and opens remediation tasks for anything below policy.

### 🔍 What it checks
- **Backup freshness & coverage** — last successful backup age per system vs RPO policy
- **RDS/DB snapshot health** — snapshot recency, retention, and cross-region copy status
- **Replication lag & status** — read replica / DR-region replication health
- **Infrastructure-as-code drift** — whether live infra matches IaC (Terraform state) so a DR rebuild would actually match production
- **Runbook staleness** — whether the DR runbook/procedure doc has been reviewed within policy window

### 🧮 Scoring
Each pillar is scored 0-100 individually, then combined into a weighted overall DR Readiness Score. Gaps below threshold automatically generate remediation tasks with owner, priority and due date.

### 🎛️ Customization
Adjust RPO/RTO thresholds, pillar weights, remediation SLAs, and the task-tracker destination to match your environment.

## 1️⃣ Start & Configure

Scheduled and manual entry points, then defines the systems under DR scope, RPO/RTO policy per system, backup/replication/runbook sources, and scoring weights.

## 2️⃣ Inspect DR Signals (parallel)

Queries backup status, RDS/DB snapshots, replication health, and IaC/Terraform state drift for every in-scope system, plus checks when the DR runbook was last reviewed.

## 3️⃣ Merge & Normalize

Combines all inspection results per system into one record so scoring has full context in a single pass.

## 4️⃣ Score Readiness & Detect Gaps

Scores each DR pillar (backup, snapshot, replication, IaC, runbook) 0-100, computes a weighted overall DR Readiness Score, and flags every gap below its policy threshold with severity.

## 5️⃣ Route, Report & Remediate

Splits systems with gaps from fully-ready systems. Gaps become remediation tasks (owner, priority, due date) pushed to the task tracker; Critical gaps also fire an urgent DR alert. A rollup DR readiness report is generated every run regardless of outcome.

nodes.name: When Daily DR Scan Starts
nodes.notes: Runs a full DR readiness inspection once per day.

nodes.name: When Test Run Initiated
nodes.notes: Lets you trigger a DR readiness scan manually for testing.

nodes.name: Set Configuration Parameters
nodes.notes: Defines in-scope systems, RPO/RTO policy, scoring weights, thresholds, and task-tracker/alert settings.

nodes.name: Split Out Systems
nodes.notes: Splits the systems array into one item per system so each can be inspected independently.

nodes.name: Attach Global Config To Each System
nodes.notes: Merges the global config (weights, thresholds, runbook info) onto each per-system item.

nodes.name: Check Backup Job Status
nodes.notes: Queries the backup service API for last successful run time, duration, and size for this system's backup job. Replace URL/auth with your actual backup provider (AWS Backup, Veeam, etc).

nodes.name: Check RDS Snapshot Status
nodes.notes: Queries the AWS RDS DescribeDBSnapshots-equivalent internal API for the most recent snapshot of this DB instance, including whether it has a cross-region copy.

nodes.name: Check Replication Health
nodes.notes: Queries replication status (replica lag, DR-region sync state) for systems that require cross-region replication.

nodes.name: Check IaC / Terraform Drift
nodes.notes: Queries Terraform Cloud/Enterprise (or your IaC pipeline) for the latest plan's drift status on this system's workspace, so a DR rebuild is verified to match what IaC would actually produce.

nodes.name: Check DR Runbook Last Review
nodes.notes: Queries the internal wiki/doc API for the DR runbook's last-modified/last-reviewed metadata.

nodes.name: Merge All DR Signals
nodes.notes: Combines backup, snapshot, replication, IaC, and runbook results back into one item per system by position.

nodes.name: Normalize & Combine Per-System Signals
nodes.notes: Flattens the five parallel HTTP responses (which arrive as separate merge branches) into one clean per-system record, failing open (marks as unknown, not critical) on any unreachable source.

nodes.name: Score DR Readiness & Detect Gaps
nodes.notes: Scores each pillar 0-100, computes the weighted overall DR readiness score, flags gaps below threshold, and appends this run to a rolling per-system readiness history.

nodes.name: If Gaps Or Below Threshold
nodes.notes: Branches on whether this system has any pillar gap or falls below the overall readiness warning threshold.

nodes.name: System Fully Ready - No Action
nodes.notes: Records that this system meets DR readiness policy this cycle.

assignments.name: note
assignments.value: =All DR pillars meet policy for {{ $json.systemId }} (overall score {{ $json.overallScore }}/100) - no remediation needed

nodes.name: Classify Priority & Build Remediation Tasks
nodes.notes: Turns each gap into a remediation task with priority, owner hint, and due date, and builds an overall alert summary for the system.

nodes.name: If Critical DR Severity
nodes.notes: Splits Critical DR readiness findings toward urgent escalation from everything else.

nodes.name: Wait Before Critical DR Escalation
nodes.notes: Holds a Critical DR finding for a short cooldown to dedup before urgent dispatch.

nodes.name: Prepare Critical DR Alert
nodes.notes: Marks the de-duped Critical DR finding as ready for urgent dispatch to on-call.

nodes.name: Prepare Standard DR Log
nodes.notes: Marks non-Critical DR findings as ready for standard logging/dispatch.

nodes.name: Split Out Remediation Tasks
nodes.notes: Splits each system's task array into individual task items for creation in the tracker.

nodes.name: Create Remediation Task in Tracker
nodes.notes: Creates a remediation task in your task tracker (Jira, Asana, Linear, etc). Replace URL/auth/body mapping for your specific tracker's API.

nodes.name: Dispatch Critical DR Alert
nodes.notes: Sends the urgent DR readiness alert to the on-call channel (Slack, PagerDuty, etc). Replace URL/auth/body mapping for your alerting tool.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ title: $json.alertTitle, description: $json.alertDescription, severity: $json.overallSeverity, team: $json.securityTeamId, systemId: $json.systemId }) }}

nodes.name: Aggregate DR Readiness Report
nodes.notes: Collects every system's scored result (gaps and no-gaps alike) into a single rollup report item for this run.

nodes.name: Build DR Readiness Rollup Summary
nodes.notes: Builds a single human-readable rollup summarizing overall program readiness across all systems for this run.
